violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: FOOD CONTAINER observed warewashed with a mixture of soap and chlorine sanitizer in one step.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS discussed washing, rinsing, and sanitizing as 3 separate steps. Container was left for dishwasher to properly wash and sanitize when they arrive.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: white sauce (68F) and hot sauce (73F) observed in ambient, containers observed with statement to refrigerate after opening. Hummus (50F) and chickpeas (46F) observed in cold service well.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Sauces placed in freezer to blast chill. Hummus and chickpeas discarded.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including food allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. OBSERVED EMPLOYEES IMPROPERLY HANDWASHING, THAWING, AND DISHWASHER UNAWARE OF THE REQUIREMENT TO SANITIZE FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. PIC MUST TRAIN EMPLOYEES ON ALL OF THE ABOVE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED AT THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED THE CFM WASH HIS HANDS WITH WATER AT THE THREE VAT SINK. OBSERVED A FOOD WORKER WASH HIS HANDS WITH WATER AT THE THREE VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. CDI: CFM AND FOOD WORKER RE-EDUCATED AND CORRECTED TO WASH THEIR HANDS PROPERLY IN THREE-VAT SINK.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED THE CFM AND THE FOOD WORKER USE 3-VAT SINK AS A HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI: CFM AND FOOD WORKER RE-EDUCATED. ONLY UTILIZE HANDWASHING SINKS FOR HANDWASHING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink IN THE SERVICE AREA being used TO STORE A SANITIZER BIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: SANITIZER BIN REMOVED FROM HANDWASHING SINK. CEASE USING HANDWASHING SINKS FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS MOVED NEAR THE HANDWASHING SINK.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BEANS BEING HELD IN A STEAM-WELL AT 84.8F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BEANS DISPOSED OF. SHAH'S HALAL FOOD (Inspection Date: 06/17/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING ON SITE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. ALL FOOD REQUIRING REFRIGERATION OR HOT HOLDING AND KEPT ON SITE FOR OVER 24HRS MUST BE DATE MARKED AS DESCRIBED ABOVE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED MULTIPLE SPRAY BOTTLES OF SANITIZER/CLEANERS WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. ALL WORKING CONTAINERS OF CHEMICALS MUST BE LABELED WITH THE COMMON NAME OF THE CHEMICAL.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED BEEF GYRO THAWING UNDER THE GRILL IN THE KITCHEN, AND OBSERVED LOOSE FISH THAWING IN THE THREE-VAT SINK. FOODS THAWING UNDER AMBIENT CONDITIONS AND WITHOUT TEMPERATURE CONTROL.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: FISH MOVED INTO THE WALK-IN COOLER AND THE BEEF GYRO MOVED INTO THE 2-DOOR PREP-TOP IN THE KITCHEN.

violations.corrective_action: Obtain a CHLORINE (BLEACH) AND QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: The diameter of the air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the THREE-VAT SINK is less than twice the diameter of the water supply inlet. OBSERVED THE SPRAY FAUCET AT THE THREE-VAT SINK TO BE ~2IN BELOW THE FLOOD LEVEL RIM.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CDI: SPRAY FAUCET HOOKED AT THE BACK OF THE SINK.
